incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 4139876543 - Orbital (org: orb-924) experiencing spike in 5xx and rate-limit hits across generate/chat-stream routes. Auto-throttle engaged for org. Paging @oncall

maria (oncall): on it, looking at dashboards now. which routes are erroring?

kevin (sre): i'm seeing elevated 503s and backlog in the GPU queue for generate.v1. Prefix cache miss rate also up. requests/sec ~ 6x baseline for orb-924.

samir (eng): confirm model-side queues backing up, kernel OOM accounted for some failures but most are intentional RL by the policy layer.

jess (support): customer-reported partial outages over last 8 minutes, ticket #CS-1291. They say most calls get 429 or time out.

maria (oncall): ok, impact = degraded generation for Orbital prod org. High business impact per support. Propose emergency per-org rate-limit bump + short window quota increase while we throttle noisy endpoints. Need approval from SRE lead + billing if cost exposure > $5k/hr.

derek (acct): i'm here — Orbital is an enterprise customer on dedicated contract. We can authorize temporary bump for 30m if it prevents data loss; coordinate billing after.

kevin (sre): plan: 1) Temporarily raise orb-924 per-second token limit from 20 TPS to 60 TPS, 2) Apply a short-lived stricter concurrency cap on chat-stream to 2 concurrent requests, 3) Disable non-essential heavy features (long-context synthesis flag) for orb-924. Monitor for abuse. Rollback if latency > 1.5s p50.

samir (eng): prepared a quick hotfix API call to adjust rate limits via admin-controlplane. use with caution.

kevin (sre): executing now.

kevin (sre): run:```bash
# bump token TPS for org orb-924 (internal admin API)
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/orgs/orb-924/rate_limits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"token_tps":60, "token_window_secs":1, "temporary":true, "expires_in_secs":1800, "reason":"emergency-bump to mitigate service outage"}'
```

ops-bot: action:rate_limit.update accepted. change_id=rl-2026-41398766. expires_at=4139878343.

maria (oncall): throttling long-context flag for orb-924 now. command:```json
{"org_id":"orb-924","feature_flags":{"long_context_synthesis":false}}
```

ops-bot: action:feature_flag.update accepted. flag_update_id=ff-2026-41398766.

jess (support): informing Orbital primary SE: "We applied a temporary rate increase + disabled long-context to stabilize. Monitoring and will update in 10m."

kevin (sre): dashboards: request rate back to ~2x baseline and error rate dropping. 5xx count down 80% since bump. Watch KV cache hit rate — still low.

samir (eng): checking model jobs - no new kernel OOMs, GPU queues draining. Good sign.

maria (oncall): leave canary window 10m. If metrics stable, we'll extend or create staged rollback plan. Who will own rollback?

kevin (sre): i'll own rollback. If p50 latency > 1s or cost accretion > $4k in 10m, we revert.

derek (acct): i'll notify billing to flag the spike and pre-approve the 30m window.

jess (support): customer update posted to CS ticket and Orbital slack: "We've applied a temporary mitigation to restore throughput. Expect full stability within 10-15 minutes."

ops-bot: monitor rule setup: create-alert "orbital-regression" threshold: 5xx_rate > 5/min for 3m, slack-channel incident-alerts.

maria (oncall): 5m stable check: 5xx rate remains low, token usage back to 1.8x baseline. leaving the temporary bump until expiry but disabling long-context continues. Start draft postmortem notes: "unexpected traffic spike from Orbital caused RL triggers; mitigation was temporary token TPS increase and feature disable; need better customer-side telemetry and optional backpressure."

kevin (sre): logging change_id rl-2026-41398766 for postmortem. recommend adding per-org burst budget to product to avoid manual hotfixes.

samir (eng): will open a ticket to add automated graceful degradation for long synthesis paths.

maria (oncall): thanks team. keep this thread updated if anything regresses. will hand off to next oncall at +30m.

derek (acct): Orbital engineer replied: "Thanks, service is back to normal. We'll patch our client to reduce sudden fanout." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident resolved? monitors show stable for 25m. note: temporary rate-limit change will auto-expire at 4139878343 unless extended.

maria (oncall): marking as mitigated. will create incident ticket INC-4139876543 and assign postmortem to samir + kevin.

jess (support): closing CS-1291 after confirmation.

kevin (sre): filing follow-up: add per-org burst controls, improve RL transparency in console, playbook for rapid approvals (billing + AE).

maria (oncall): signing off — handing to night oncall in 28m. good job everyone. :tada:
